'''Kenpa''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the struggle between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He sold items aboard the Republic's [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />
